Definition: from the same as G196; exactness:--perfect manner.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in Paul's defence before the Jerusalem crowd: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers. The word is exactness — the strict, precise, careful way he was taught the law.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for exactness is a credential, not a doctrine, and it carries little weight on its own; its weight is the man, Paul trained in precision and turned to grace.
